- Modify: data/2021a_ssh_mapping_ose/ours/stage_miost_gate_results.json (script writes phase8.covariate_alignment)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Proxy = per-cell temporal std of stage_b_mean_maps.nc on the 25-cell (2 deg) grid

tasks.subject: Task 7: Floored MLE fitters + tail diagnostic + safeguard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** One criterion, all lanes: NLL/grad under r ~ N(0, s(x)v + sigma_obs^2); lane-A Newton; lane-B L-BFGS-B; tail diagnostic; safeguard.

**Files:**
- Create: src/sverdrup/application/calibration/likelihood.py
- Test: tests/test_calibration_likelihood.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- nll/grad exact plan formulas (tot = s v + SIGMA_OBS2; w = 0.5 (s v/tot)(1 - r2/tot))
- fit_region_newton: init log(mean(r2/v)); NEWTON_MAX_ITER 50 / NEWTON_TOL 1e-10; sigma=0 limit returns mean(r2/v) to 1e-12
- fit_poly_lbfgsb: scipy L-BFGS-B jac=grad gtol 1e-8, init (log S_STAR, 0...); optimizer+gtol in fit_id
- tail_diagnostic: median(r2/(s v + floor))/0.4549 ratio; >= 1.5 flags report-only
- assert_beats_scalar raises when fitted NLL > s*-constant NLL

**Verify:** pixi run pytest tests/test_calibration_likelihood.py -v


tasks.subject: Task 8: Fold machinery + selection
tasks.description:
**Goal:** T/S folds, guard rings, rho-hat/n_eff, merge rule, pool-then-max statistics, lane-0 eligibility, lexicographic selection.

**Files:**
- Create: src/sverdrup/application/calibration/folds.py
- Test: tests/test_calibration_folds.py

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- t_folds: 6 pinned rotations (T_FOLDS)
- s_fold_layout(salt): derive_seed(miost, phase8, s-folds, salt) permutation of 25 blocks, split (7,6,6,6); guard ring 0.5 deg excluded from BOTH masks; >=50%-per-fit-region constraint else salt+1 recorded
- rho_hat along-pass, k<=20 truncated at rho<0.05; n_eff = n/(1+2 sum rho)
- merge_small_blocks: n_eff < 200 -> nearest-centroid same-fold, lowest-index tie-break
- pooled_worst_region: pool per region across folds -> |coverage-0.6827| -> max
- select: lane-0 eligibility then lexicographic S -> T -> smooth preference (poly > covariate > piecewise); (winner|None, table); None = negative result

**Verify:** pixi run pytest tests/test_calibration_folds.py -v

